notes.title: The release date for “and Roger” has been set for July 24, 2025!
notes.notes:
The release date of and Roger has been set for July 24, 2025! 

To commemorate this, we've released an interview video "and Roger behind the scenes - yona edition" with creator yona, who worked on its production. 


[previewyoutube="JFP0yfKmWis;full"][/previewyoutube]


"Why did I decide to make this game?"

 "What were the particularities in the expression of art and story?"

 "What is necessary for indie games?"



 This interview video features yona himself discussing the background of the production and his thoughts on this work. Please take a look!
